The *Cetanālakkhaṇapañha* ("The Question on the Mark of Intention", Mil 3.3.11) is a section of the *Milindapañha* that addresses the defining characteristic or mark of intention (*cetanā*). Modern translations include an English rendering by John Kelly, alongside versions in other languages.

A full parallel to the dialogue is preserved in the Chinese Buddhist canon under the title *The Characteristics of Thought* (T 1670b 2.33).
